name: Cisco pyATS Docker Image
what_it_is: Official Docker image for Cisco's pyATS (Python Automated Test Systems) framework, providing a pre-configured Python virtual environment for network test automation. Ships as ciscotestautomation/pyats on Docker Hub with multiple image variants targeting different use cases and architectures.
components: tini init process (v0.18.0, zombie process reaper)
docker-entrypoint.sh (workspace activation and one-time init logic)
easypy test runner (CLI for running pyATS job files)
measurement: Test job execution via easypy runner (pass/fail results)
No built-in metrics export or time-series measurement; results captured by pyATS job output
configuration: WORKSPACE env var (default /pyats) — sets virtualenv and working directory
pyats_version build arg — controls installed pyATS version
Volume-mount /pyats/requirements.txt to auto-install pip packages on first container start
Volume-mount /pyats/workspace.init bash script for custom initialization (git clone, ssh-keyscan, dev installs)
One-time init guarded by /pyats/.initialized sentinel file — re-mount new container to re-run init
modes: Direct test job execution (docker run ... easypy <job.py>)
Alpine-full image variant (full extras on Alpine)
constraints: One-time initialization: /pyats/.initialized sentinel prevents requirements.txt and workspace.init from re-running on container restart — must start a fresh container to re-trigger init
No docker-compose.yml provided in the repository — single-container usage only; multi-container orchestration must be user-defined
Workspace volume (/pyats) declared as Docker volume, so container content persists between reloads but init scripts only execute once per container lifecycle
Network device connections depend on external device availability — the image provides SSH/Telnet clients but no simulated device environment
docker_services: ciscotestautomation/pyats:<version> (pinned version tags available on Docker Hub)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in repo — no pre-built multi-service topology
No simulated/virtual network devices bundled — real or separately provisioned devices required for end-to-end testing
No test result export integrations (e.g., JUnit XML, Prometheus) out of the box
No pre-installed Genie or unicon libraries in base image (available in full variant only)
No CI/CD pipeline configuration examples in the repository
